introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce: Lie down on your side with your head rested on your left arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.\n\nMake sure your right leg goes straight up and down during the exercise. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce:
Lie down on your side with your head rested on your right arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.

Make sure your left leg goes straight up and down during the exercise.

It's a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on the ground with your legs bent and your arms by your sides. \n\nSlightly lift your upper body off the floor and make your hands alternately reach your heels.
name: HEEL TOUCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your neck in a natural position.
Keep your lower back on the floor.
Engage your core.
Exhale when touching your heels and inhale when going back.
It's a great exercise for all of your abdominal muscles.

introduce:
Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands directly under your shoulders. 

Then take a breath in and make your belly fall down, shoulders roll back and head come up towards the ceiling. 

As you exhale, round your spine toward the ceiling and draw your navel up towards your spine, and drop your head.

Repeat the exercise, matching the movement to your breath.
name: CAT COW POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure your palms are directly under your shoulders.
Please make sure your knees are directly under your hips.
Inhale as your belly falls down, and exhale as your belly curves in.
This exercise works on your spine, back and abs.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs straight and feet close together. Place your hands beneath your shoulders, and bend your elbows close to your body.

Inhale deeply, press your palms into the floor, lifting your chest and shoulders off the ground. Keep your hips pressed firmly into the floor. 

Hold for a few breaths, raise and lower with your breath. On inhale, lift into spinal extension. On exhale, soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
name: COBRA STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Inhale to lift the chest. Exhale to soften the shoulders and deepen the stretch.
This exercise stretches your abdominals.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. \n\nPut your hands behind you and interlock them. Then pull your elbows back and extend your arms. Hold it for a few seconds.
name: CLASP HANDS BEHIND BACK

tips.text: Please always keep your upper body straight.
This exercise helps to relieve neck tension and pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Start in the straight arm plank position with your hands under your shoulders and feet together.\n\nHop your feet apart and land on your toes, then hop back. Repeat the exercise.
name: PLANK JACKS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your upper body stable.
Your body should be in a straight line.
Don't sink or raise your hips.
It is a good exercise for your abs, core, shoulders, and lower back.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground. \n\nRaise your legs to the tabletop position; drop your left foot towards the ground. Tap the ground with your toes; then raise the leg back. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: TOE TAP

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your knee steady as you drop your leg towards the ground.
Exhale as you drop your leg; inhale as you bring it back.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground hip-width apart and your arms straight by your sides. \n\nLift your hips up off the ground into a butt bridge position. Lift one knee up towards your chest, and then lower it back without dropping your hips. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: MARCHING HIP RAISES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes as you lift your hips.
Please don\'t tuck your chin.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your left leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your right leg forward. Put your left hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the left. Bend your right elbow and hook it on the outside of your left knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your left shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce:
Sit upright on the floor. Bend your right leg with your heel close to your sit bone. Extend your left leg forward. Put your right hand on the floor behind you for support. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, twist your upper body to the right. Bend your left elbow and hook it on the outside of your right knee, fingers pointing upward. Turn your gaze over your right shoulder.

Hold this position. With each inhale, lengthen your spine. With each exhale, gently rotate your body deeper into the twist.
name: SAGE MARICHI'S POSE Ⅲ RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back straight.
Keep your legs still when twisting your body.
Twist from your waist instead of your chest.
Evenly distribute your weight between both sit bones.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale to lengthen your spine, exhale to deepen the twist.
If sitting upright is challenging, place a block under your buttocks.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, chest, and spine.
This exercise helps relieve your back and hip pain.

introduce: Start on all fours. Exhale as you lift your hips into an inverted ‘V’ shape, and lengthen your spine.\n\nAlternately lift and lower your heels with steady breath.
name: WALK THE DOG

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Relax your neck.
Keep a steady and even breathing rhythm without holding your breath.
Notice the elongation from your fingertips to your sit bone.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears.
Please press all areas of the palms equally on the floor.
This exercise stretches your shoulders, hamstrings, calves, and arches.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your arms extended forward.

Inhale, raise your shoulders away from the mat as you circle the arms out to the sides, then around to the hips with palms facing your body.

Exhale, bend your arms to reach forward to the start position.

Repeat the exercise.
name: BREASTSTROKE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do it slowly to get a better result.
Please don't let your arms touch the ground during the exercise.
Please extend the upper back and neck.
Please keep bottom rib in contact with the mat.
This exercise can help build your endurance.
This exercise strengthens the muscles of your scapular region.

introduce:
Lie flat on a mat, extend your legs at an angle from the mat. Engage your core, lift your shoulders off the mat with arms straight by your ears, shoulder-width apart. Inhale to prepare.

Exhale, bend your knees towards your chest as you sweep your arms out to the sides, reaching around to grasp your shins or ankles and squeeze.

Inhale, reach your arms over your head and keep your legs long.

Repeat the exercise.
name: DOUBLE LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your shoulders lifted.
Please keep your core engaged.
This exercise can stabilize your core muscles.
This exercise helps with your abdominal strength.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back, and bend your knees into the chest. Place your hands behind your head to support your head with your fingertips.

Lift your head, neck, and shoulders off the mat, engaging your abdominal muscles.

Extend your right leg out straight into the air while simultaneously rotating your upper body to bring your right elbow towards your left bent knee. 

Switch your legs as you bring your left elbow toward your right knee. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CRISS CROSS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do not strain your neck and head.
Please keep your core tight.
Please do not hold your breath.
Please keep the elbows wide.
Please make sure your pelvis is stable.
This exercise helps you build strong obliques and a more defined waistline.

introduce:
Start with a straight arm plank with your legs and feet together. 

Exhale, lift one leg up as high as you can with your foot pointed. Inhale as you lower your leg back to the start position. 

Switch your legs and repeat the exercise.
name: LEG PULL FRONT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do not drop your hips.
Please keep your legs stretched.
Please make sure your trunk is stable as you move your leg.
This exercise helps improve stability in the shoulders and trunk.
It's a great exercise to train your legs, hamstrings, back, abdominals, shoulders, and arms.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms reaching overhead. Keep your legs together and your toes pointed. Inhale to prepare. 

Exhale, begin to slowly peel your spine off the mat, one vertebra at a time until your body is in a seated position, with your arms reaching towards your toes.

Inhale at the top, and as you exhale, slowly begin to roll back down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: ROLL UP

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please initiate the movement from your core, instead of your arms.
This exercise can strengthen abdominal muscles.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms resting by your sides.

Extend your legs toward the ceiling. Engage your core muscles to lift your shoulders off the mat. Hold your right ankle with both hands. Lower your left leg at an angle.

Pull your right leg once. Switch legs and repeat the exercise.
name: SINGLE STRAIGHT LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and trunk stable.
Please keep your legs straight.
You can adjust the angle of your leg and the position of your hands on your leg.
This exercise challenges the abdominal muscles.
This exercise can stretch the hamstring muscles of the back of the thighs.

introduce: Lie face down on a mat with your hands by your head and your legs hip-width apart. Push the ground with your arms to lift your upper body.\n\nStretch your arms backward. Keep your body tight and position locked. Rock your body back and forth.
name: SWAN DIVE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your legs straight.
Please coordinate your breath with your move.
Please keep your core tight.
Please do not tense your neck and shoulders.
This exercise helps to strengthen and lengthen the back muscles.
This exercise can improve your posture and build core strength.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended into the air. Lift your shoulders off the mat with arms extended parallel to the ground.

Inhale through your nose for a count of 5, then exhale through your mouth for a count of 5 while simultaneously pumping your arms up and down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: THE HUNDRED

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please control your breathing and your movements.
Please keep your legs straight.
Please do not strain your neck and head.
This exercise can strengthen your core and back.
